This is a primary final replication report dated November 16, 2020, containing results, methods, deviations and the matching full Li (2011) reference. The supplied reference lists additional authors and a November 18, 2025 date, which are not established by this report; the project code, lead investigator, original reference and OSF file identifier establish intended source identity. No replication DOI supplied or printed. Canonical text contains the five-page report, not merely an abstract. Footnote 1 documents unstandardized coefficients; no conversion performed. Same-test printed p = 0.006154 is context only, outside the assigned unfinished field. Table 1 reproduction and Table 3 combined-data results are separately labelled analyses. Only es_value_r is assigned; other fields are unassigned placeholders. No PDF path supplied.
